name: Codie Nyhan
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Codie has experience in the assessment and treatment of chronic pain, post-traumatic stress disorder, obsessive compulsive disorder, personality disorders and various anxiety/depressive disorders. The practice helps with depression, anxiety, stress, trauma, eating disorders, interpersonal difficulties, low self-esteem and emotional regulation difficulties, offering a combination of online psychological counselling and face to face sessions.
specialties: PTSD, trauma, chronic pain, OCD, personality disorders, WorkCover/TAC/NDIS
